messages.text: Decided: replace the `sudo ln` with a `java/loader.mac` that exports JAVA_HOME from the keg's static path (no fork, no write), instead of keeping a link into /Library/Java (because the loader needs neither root nor a write). Decided: installer package name changed from `java` to `openjdk` (because the old link path `opt/openjdk` only exists when the formula is `openjdk`; `brew install java` could not be verified here). Note: the Actual outcome says the link is created inside /opt/homebrew — it is actually created under /Library/Java and points into brew's prefix. Machines that already ran the old installer keep that root-owned link; it is not removed.

Decided while you were away: landing `0085d5ddb25a`, check green (because the installer no longer writes outside the repo or needs root; `java/loader.mac` sets `JAVA_HOME` from the keg's static path, guarded; the check now forbids `ln` into `/opt/homebrew/opt/` too). Accepted: the formula is `openjdk`; `JAVA_HOME` over `/usr/libexec/java_home`, which would need the removed link. For the user: machines that ran the old installer keep a root-owned link at `/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/openjdk.jdk`, removable by hand with sudo; task 17 moves the loader out of ordinary shells.
